reason: The analyst reports a single specification that restricts to the central region (about a third of the 2000 firms) with no stated justification and trims the outcome, then generalizes it to the whole question. It also omits most pre-period controls and does not disclose the other region subsamples. The full-sample adjusted estimate is -0.275 (SE 0.24), and the central-only estimate of +0.12 is a subgroup result. The headline 'no effect' matches my result, but this specification is not adequately supported.
